name: frond1
prompt:
Generate ONE photorealistic botanical texture asset of a single sword fern frond, matching the supplied project's fern_frond.png botanical reference (reference only, not an edit target). Isolated on genuine transparent alpha, no background, no ground, no shadow. An orthographic top-down macro scan, as a pressed fresh frond laid perfectly FLAT on a table. Central rachis nearly straight and vertical; foot at bottom, tip at top. Entire frond fits with clear padding. Simple single rows of paired lanceolate pinnae, NOT lacy twice-divided bracken, each with fine serrated edges and visible delicate natural veins; longest pinnae slightly below blade middle, small toward base and tip. Green blades lie flat open toward camera. Lower 20 percent of total length is a bare slender stalk. Subtle imperfect leaf spacing and natural asymmetry. Surface intrinsic albedo only, diffuse even shadowless illumination, no directional lighting, highlights or dark occlusion baked in. Excellent photographic microtexture. No text or labels, no additional fronds. Use tall portrait framing with the frond nearly full image height.
Variant: Fresh and bright yellow-green mature frond, intact tapered tip. Real dimensions 1.10 m long and 0.22 m maximum wide, long slender sword profile with about 31 pairs of pinnae.
